refutes.statement: Conjecture DL_RC (ledger K4.DL2.RC; k4/dlrc.c header): at f >= 1 every min-frozen P with def(P) > 0 has a min-frozen P' with def(P') < def(P) reached by a move of R_C = T1 (re-base) + T2 (rotation of free agents) + T3+ (the frozen-chain role swap: NA kept, exactly one x frozen -> free, exactly one z free -> frozen needing its new good in P, W the changed agents frozen in both, at most one helper free in both giving up a good of its base, the bases of W + z in P' exactly those of W + x in P) + T4 (frozen agents permute their goods). Here f = 2, def(P) = 1 at the four states P = ({4}, {1,8}, {10,11}, B_3, {9}), B_3 = {5}, {5,6}, {5,7}, {6,7}; no better min-frozen state lies within distance 3, and every one at distance 4 is a role swap with TWO helpers, each giving up a good

DL_RC with T3+'s helper unrestricted (ledger K4.DL2.RCY; portfolio predicate RC_Yfree of compute/k4-portfolio): at most one helper, which need not give up a good. Every better state of the four P has two helpers (distance 4) or is a double role swap with |U| = |Z| = 2 (distance 5)
Conjecture DL_RT4 (ledger K4.DL2.RT4; k4/dlrt4.c header): the same with T3 (W empty) in place of T3+. P refutes DL_RT4 at f = 2, not by a chain state

repair.move: role swap with two helpers (not R_C, not RCY): agent 0 (frozen on 4, which agent 3 needs) releases 4 for {0} and becomes free; agent 3 takes {4} and freezes; helpers 1 ({1,8} -> {1,10}) and 2 ({10,11} -> {3}) both give up goods; NA = {4, 9} kept. At distance 5, e.g. ({0}, {1,10}, {9}, {4}, {5}) with def -1: a double role swap (agents 0 and 4 out, 2 and 3 in) with one helper

key_form.move: a T3 move (x = 0 -> {0}, z = 3 -> {4}, no helper) from another state of P's key (def* = 1; all 60 states of the key have def 1) to a key with def* = -1, so DL on the key graph holds
